messages:
alex: Quick sync — after yesterday's perf regression we need to add token-level latency breakdowns to the runtime metrics and change the metrics schema to include kernel/batching/KV labels. Current dashboards can't isolate kernel selection or KV-hit behavior.

maria: +1. Can you sketch required labels? we should be careful about cardinality.

alex: Draft labels I had in mind: model, model_variant, kernel (e.g. triton/tvm/cuda), kernel_version, batch_size_bucket, seq_len_bucket, token_phase (prefill/decode), kv_hit (true/false), route (api path), deployment_tier, metrics_schema_version.

sanjay: batch_size_bucket and seq_len_bucket are good — avoid raw ints for labels. Also suggest quantization_profile (q4/q8/fp16) and hardware_class (A100/H100) but those add cardinality.

maria: Important callout: route and model_variant explode combinatorially. We should enforce a max label cardinality for route (e.g., map routes to coarse groups: chat/rerank/embed) and use route_group.

jamie: Agree. Also token_phase is crucial to see prefill vs decode costs per-token. Example metric name proposal: redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{metrics_schema_version="v2",model="mistral-7b",model_variant="v1",kernel="triton",kernel_version="2.1.0",batch_size_bucket="1",seq_len_bucket="1-32",token_phase="decode",kv_hit="true",route_group="chat"}  42

maria: That looks ok. Two concerns: 1) how do dashboards handle queries across many labels? 2) migration path from current schema (which uses model, route only).

alex: Migration idea: keep metrics_schema_version label and emit both old metric name (redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_v1) and new name (redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_v2) for a 2-week overlap. Dashboards will be updated to v2, with fallbacks to v1 for historical comparisons. Add a job to backfill aggregates for the last 30d into v2 rollups.

sanjay: For ingestion costs we can't increase cardinality too much. Proposed limits: route_group max 50, model_variant max 30, kernel * kernel_version pairs limited. For batch_size_bucket use coarse buckets: 1, 2-4, 5-16, 17-64, 65+. seq_len buckets: 1-32, 33-128, 129-512, 513+.

maria: Also add a token_index_bucket? we sometimes see decode latency growth with token position. We could do token_pos_group: early/mid/late based on percentiles rather than raw position to limit cardinality.

jamie: Good idea. For dashboards: build derived metrics that roll up over high-cardinality labels so queries are cheap. e.g., redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_agg_by_model_and_phase{...} which sums/counts across kernel and route. Use precomputed materialized views in the metrics backend.

alex: Example PromQL snippets we might add to dashboards: 
```
# p50 token latency during decode for model v2, KV hits only
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{metrics_schema_version="v2",model="mistral-7b",model_variant="v2",token_phase="decode",kv_hit="true"}[5m])) by (le))
```

maria: +1. Also add a dashboard panel that flags regression signals: delta in p50/p95 by kernel_version or kv_hit over 24h. We should send alerts when p95 increases > 20% for any kernel_version.

sanjay: Alerting note: only fire if the affected label group has sufficient traffic (>1000 tokens/min) to avoid noisy alerts on low-volume combos.

ops-bot: Epic created: ENGRT-6423 "metrics schema v2 + token-level dashboards" (owner: jamie).

jamie: I'll take the dashboard work and the PromQL examples. alex — can you own the runtime emitter changes (adding labels + schema_version) and the migration plan?

alex: Yep. I'll open a PR to emit v2 metrics behind a feature flag, roll it out to canary, then enable global for 48h overlap. I'll also add an option to anonymize or map routes to route_group at emission time.

maria: I'll do the schema doc and cardinality limits, plus a short runbook for investigating regressions (how to pivot from route_group->route mapping).

sanjay: I'll add kernel selection traces into the profiler so kernel_version is always available for a given request; that'll make labels accurate. Also will add a test harness to simulate high-cardinality traffic and measure TSDB ingestion.

alex: Action items: 
- alex: PR for emitter + feature flag + route_group mapping.
- jamie: dashboard panels + alert rules + PromQL snippets.
- maria: schema doc, label limits, runbook.
- sanjay: profiler + kernel_version plumbing + ingestion test.
- ops-bot: create rollout checklist + monitor for increased TSDB cardinality cost.

maria: ETA proposal: schema doc + limits by EOD Thurs, emitter PR early next week, dashboards + alerts in 2 weeks.

alex: Sounds good. If no objections I'll create the PR and the feature-flag ticket today.

jamie: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: Please tag #costs when you have ingestion estimates.

alex: Will do. I'll paste initial cardinality estimate in the PR.

maria: Thanks everyone — this will help pinpoint kernel and KV regressions fast.
